ship_explorer.notes: Nose points to -Z in Godot. Hull = root mesh, every other node is its descendant. GEAR: Gear_Front, Gear_RearL, Gear_RearR have their origin exactly on the hinge, rotation 0, legs hang straight down (extended). To RETRACT rotate each of the three nodes about its local X axis by -90 degrees (Godot rotation.x = -PI/2; feet swing to +Z = tail and up); the legs then disappear completely inside the hull / engine pods. Marker_FootFront/RearL/RearR = bottom centre of the foot pads (ground contact, all at y=-3.0 in model space). Hull origin = centre of the ship; belly is 1.6 m above the ground with the gear extended. Cockpit_Interior is its own node (hide it for first person if desired); Cockpit_Glass uses the Glass material (alpha 0.25, double sided). Marker_Eye = pilot eye (inside canopy, 0.65 m above the seat). Engine_L/Engine_R = engine pods, each with child Engine_Glow_L/R (material Emissive_Engine, origin = centre of the nozzle exit plane; scale/hide it to modulate thrust). Marker_EngineL/R = nozzle exit centre (exhaust flows towards +Z). Marker_Exit = point on the ground plane 3 m to the left of the side hatch (Marker_Hatch, left side, -X). Marker_Headlight_L/R at the nose. Light_Nav_L (red, left/-X), Light_Nav_R (green, right/+X), Light_Beacon (amber, on the fin). Materials: Hull_Paint, Hull_Accent, Hull_Dark, Metal, Rubber, Glass, Emissive_Engine, Emissive_Light, Emissive_Amber, Emissive_Screen, Emissive_ScreenAmber, Emissive_NavRed, Emissive_NavGreen, Emissive_Window, Emissive_Beacon. Wingspan 12.9 m, length 14.0 m.

astronaut.notes: Faces -Z in Godot (+Y in Blender). Origin = on the ground between the feet, height 1.8 m, relaxed A-pose (arms ~17 deg out, palms inward, knees straight). Every joint is its own mesh node with its ORIGIN ON THE JOINT, rotation 0 / scale 1, nested as: Pelvis(hip centre) > [Torso(waist) > [Head(neck) > Visor, Arm_L_Upper(shoulder) > Arm_L_Lower(elbow) > Hand_L(wrist), Arm_R_*, Backpack > Marker_JetL/R, Chest_Light, Marker_Eye], Leg_L_Upper(hip) > Leg_L_Lower(knee) > Foot_L(ankle), Leg_R_*]. _L = character's left = -X. Marker_Eye is a child of Torso (does not follow Head rotation). Marker_Tool = right palm. Marker_JetL/R = nozzle exit centres (flame goes along -Y Godot, i.e. down). Godot rotation conventions: rotation.x > 0 swings a limb FORWARD (towards -Z) - use it for the walk cycle on Arm_*_Upper/Leg_*_Upper/Leg_*_Lower; arms out (abduction): Arm_R_Upper rotation.z = +angle, Arm_L_Upper rotation.z = -angle. Limbs overlap with joint balls so no gaps at +-60 deg. Materials: Suit_White, Suit_Accent (orange), Suit_Dark, Metal, Visor (metal 0.9, rough 0.08, amber), Emissive_Light (chest light, helmet lamps), Emissive_Jet (jetpack core + nozzle glow).

landing_pad.notes: Round landing pad, diameter 16 m. Origin = pad centre on the top surface (top at y=0 in Godot, body extends down to y=-1.2 so it can sink into sloped ground). Inset ship glyph in the centre (nose towards -Z Godot), diagonal hazard ring (yellow/black), 12 recessed edge lights on the rim chamfer (alternating Emissive_Amber / Emissive_Light = warm white), 3 light pylons on the rim (angles 90/210/330 deg in Blender), service hatch with a step on the +Z (Godot) side. Single mesh node 'Body'. Materials: Pad_Plate, Pad_Side, Pad_Marking, Pad_Seam, Hazard_Yellow, Hazard_Black, Hull_Dark, Hull_Accent, Metal, Emissive_Light, Emissive_Amber.

Windows use Emissive_Window (warm amber), the airlock frame uses Emissive_Light (mint). Utility pipes, a tank and a generator box are on the +Z (Godot) back side. moon_rock_a.notes: Sharp angular regolith rock ~2.6 x 1.5 x 1.9 m (convex faceted hull with chipped edges + a smaller fragment on each side). Rock_A is recoloured by the game with the planet's rock tint; the model is completely flat shaded with crisp facets (no smoothing). Origin = ground contact near the main rock. Single mesh node 'Body'.

moon_rock_b.notes: Flat shard-like rock ~2.9 x 1.5 x 2.7 m: a big leaning wedge plate, a second plate leaning against it, a flat shard and a splinter (all crisp facets). Collision = box around everything. Rock_A is recoloured by the game with the planet's rock tint; the model is completely flat shaded with crisp facets (no smoothing). Origin = ground contact near the big plate. Single mesh node 'Body'.

probe_wreck.notes: Old crashed probe ~3.3 m (mast) / ~5 m wide: tilted boxy bus (Metal, scorched lower half + panels in Hull_Dark), torn parabolic dish leaning on the ground (dented, 2 of 3 feed struts intact), bent mast with cross bar, solar array with a hinged bent second panel (Hull_Dark cells, Metal ribs), a fuel tank sphere, scattered plates and one tiny red blink lamp (Emissive_Light, red in this GLB). NOT tinted (only Metal / Hull_Dark / Emissive_Light). Collision box covers the bus + dish area only (cap 1.7 m high), not the mast / panels. Origin = ground contact below the bus. Single mesh node 'Body'.

space_station.notes: Orbital station, real size: ring outer diameter 150 m (inner 114 m), whole model 154 x 121 x 185 m (Godot x, y, z) (game scales x2.4). Node tree: Station (root mesh: hub, solar wings, antennas, radiator fins, docking pier + bay) > Ring (rotating ring + hub collar + 4 spokes + 4 docking ports + hull plates; ORIGIN EXACTLY AT THE HUB CENTRE (0,0,0), rotation 0, scale 1; spin it around its local Y axis (= Blender Z) - the spokes and collar belong to the Ring mesh on purpose so they turn with it) and Marker_Dock (empty at the docking bay mouth, 106.6 m from the hub along -Z Godot, 33 m 'up' in Godot Y; +Y Blender / -Z Godot = out of the bay, bay opening 21 m wide x 15 m high, 36 m deep). The docking pier sits above the ring plane (Godot +Y side) so the ring never sweeps through it. Materials (fixed colours, nothing tinted): Hull_Paint (white), Hull_Accent (orange), Hull_Dark, Metal, Solar_Cell / Solar_Grid, Emissive_Window (warm window strips on the ring), Emissive_Light (cyan guide lights in the bay + port lights), Emissive_Amber, Emissive_Screen, Emissive_NavRed / Emissive_NavGreen (mouth corner lights). Origin = hub centre.

creature_grazer.notes: Chunky four-legged herbivore ~2.4 m long, 1.5 m tall (horn tips): barrel body with shoulder hump, tabby teal stripes on the tan back, cream belly + socks, dark hooves, big head with curved banded horns, ears, teal crest, tufted teal tail. Nodes: Body (root) > Head (pivot at the neck (0, 0.93, -0.71) Godot), Tail (pivot at the tail root, swings about Y), Leg_FL / Leg_FR / Leg_BL / Leg_BR (pivots at the hips/shoulders, 0.65 m above the ground, whole leg + hoof as one mesh, swing about X). L = -X. Fixed colours (the game does not tint creatures; Fur_* / Skin_* / Shell_* / Horn / Hoof / Eye_* keep their colour). Front = -Z Godot (+Y Blender). Every joint is its own mesh node whose ORIGIN IS ON THE JOINT (rotation 0, scale 1, rest pose = neutral standing / flying), children of the root mesh. Joint names are exactly what scripts/world/fauna.gd looks up. Materials: Fur_Tan, Fur_Cream, Fur_Teal, Horn, Hoof, Skin_Nose, Eye_Dark, Eye_White. Origin = ground contact below the body centre.

creature_flyer.notes: Pterosaur / manta glider, wingspan 2.7 m, ~2.9 m nose to tail fin: flat blue body, big eyes, yellow beak, swept-back orange head crest, long tail with an orange diamond fin and a small vertical fin, two broad cambered wings (blue top, peach underside, orange leading edge + tips, scalloped trailing edge, slight droop). Nodes: Body (root) > Wing_L (-X) / Wing_R (+X) (pivot at the wing root on the body side (+-0.22, 0.03, -0.04) Godot; the game flaps them by rotation.z = +-flap, wings extend outwards along +-X), Tail (optional, pivot at the tail root). Fixed colours (the game does not tint creatures; Fur_* / Skin_* / Shell_* / Horn / Hoof / Eye_* keep their colour). Front = -Z Godot (+Y Blender). Every joint is its own mesh node whose ORIGIN IS ON THE JOINT (rotation 0, scale 1, rest pose = neutral standing / flying), children of the root mesh. Joint names are exactly what scripts/world/fauna.gd looks up. Materials: Skin_Back, Skin_Belly, Skin_Wing, Skin_WingUnder, Skin_Crest, Skin_Beak, Eye_Dark, Eye_White. Origin = body centre (gliders: no collision).

creature_floater.notes: Jellyfish-like sky drifter: translucent lavender bell diameter ~3.2 m (Skin_Bell alpha 0.58, scalloped ruffled rim) with a glowing core + 8 radial glow canals (Glow_Main), 3 frilly pink oral arms (Skin_Arm, ~2.1 m) and 8 violet tentacles (Skin_Tentacle, 3.4 / 4.1 m long, glowing bands + tips + rim knobs in Glow_Main). Nodes: Bell (root mesh, pivot = bell centre = model origin; the game pulses its scale) > Tentacle_01 ... Tentacle_08 (children of Bell, pivot at the rim attachment point 1.4 m from the axis, 0.14 m below the bell centre; hang ~4 m down, the game sways them about X/Z). Fixed colours (the game does not tint creatures; Fur_* / Skin_* / Shell_* / Horn / Hoof / Eye_* keep their colour). Front = -Z Godot (+Y Blender). Every joint is its own mesh node whose ORIGIN IS ON THE JOINT (rotation 0, scale 1, rest pose = neutral standing / flying), children of the root mesh. Joint names are exactly what scripts/world/fauna.gd looks up. Glow_Main default colour baked into this GLB = cyan (#7FF2FF, emission 3.0); the game may tint it. Origin = bell centre; bell top +1.16 m, tentacle tips -4.3 m.

creature_crawler.notes: Beetle / crab ~0.95 m wide: rust-red domed carapace (Shell_Main, dark rim Shell_Dark, light rear plate Shell_Light) with 8 glowing spots (Glow_Main), dark head shield, two eye stalks with big eyes, two small pincers, six legs. Nodes: Body (root) > Leg_1 ... Leg_6 (pivots at the hips 0.19 m above the ground; 1/3/5 = left (-X) front to back, 2/4/6 = right; swing about X). Fixed colours (the game does not tint creatures; Fur_* / Skin_* / Shell_* / Horn / Hoof / Eye_* keep their colour). Front = -Z Godot (+Y Blender). Every joint is its own mesh node whose ORIGIN IS ON THE JOINT (rotation 0, scale 1, rest pose = neutral standing / flying), children of the root mesh. Joint names are exactly what scripts/world/fauna.gd looks up. Glow_Main default colour baked into this GLB = aqua green (#46FFC8, emission 3.0); the game may tint it. Materials: Shell_Main/Dark/Light, Skin_Under, Eye_Dark, Eye_White. Origin = ground contact below the body centre.

asteroid_a.notes: Elongated bent potato ~33 x 17 x 15 m: long ridge along the top, a big gouge crater and 6 smaller craters, slight neck pinch in the middle. Real size (game scales x0.35 - 1.9 and spins them). Flat shaded Rock_A (main) + Rock_B (crater floors / noise patches), both recoloured by the game's rock tint. Cube-sphere base displaced by noise + craters, plus 3 half-buried chunks. Origin = centre of the rock. Single mesh node 'Body'. No collision (the game handles proximity itself).

asteroid_b.notes: Round pitted rock ~29 m: 15 craters of various sizes (two big ones) with raised rims. Real size (game scales x0.35 - 1.9 and spins them). Flat shaded Rock_A (main) + Rock_B (crater floors / noise patches), both recoloured by the game's rock tint. Cube-sphere base displaced by noise + craters, plus 3 half-buried chunks. Origin = centre of the rock. Single mesh node 'Body'. No collision (the game handles proximity itself).

asteroid_c.notes: Two-lobed rock ~32 x 21 x 22 m (lobes 22 m and 18 m) with a deep crack ring between the lobes, three flat fracture facets and 5 craters. Real size (game scales x0.35 - 1.9 and spins them). Flat shaded Rock_A (main) + Rock_B (crater floors / noise patches), both recoloured by the game's rock tint. Cube-sphere base displaced by noise + craters, plus 3 half-buried chunks. Origin = centre of the rock. Single mesh node 'Body'. No collision (the game handles proximity itself).

satellite.notes: Derelict comms satellite ~9.5 m wide x 7 m tall x 4.8 m deep (incl. whip antenna): gold-foil bus 1.6 x 1.6 x 1.7 m with white top module + dark thruster module + scorch marks, big dented dish (2.6 m) on a mast with feed arms, small side dish, whip antennas (one bent), two solar wings (left: flat + bent panel, right: flat + torn stub), loose cable, thruster nozzle, one dim red nav lamp (Emissive_NavRed). Materials: Foil_Gold, Scorch, Hull_Paint, Hull_Dark, Metal, Solar_Cell, Solar_Grid, Emissive_NavRed (fixed colours, nothing tinted). Origin = centre of the bus (the game spins it about a random axis). Single mesh node 'Body'. No collision.
